proposal.reasoning:
SETUP. Native scan 3094x4489. Ink-projection over y=850-3400 finds exactly 14 inked column runs plus the bottom-margin page number: x=934-1017 (running header + page number stacked), 1080-1155, 1204-1284, 1356-1418, 1461-1545, 1592-1676, 1729-1809, 1858-1950, 1991-2077, 2124-2218, 2264-2344, 2384-2476, 2482-2530 (a narrow small-type shoulder note), 2527-2617, 2656-2743. Everything else on the leaf is blank paper, faint facing-page bleed-through (the grey speckle around x=1450-1560, y=2000-2600, much lighter ink, NOT boxed), or binding/scan-frame black.

MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. There is exactly ONE circle on the page, at x=2411-2477, y=1010-1060, and it is followed immediately by the field label 合高, not by a domain name + 藩. It is therefore a bullet on a total line, the same use as the ○合 bullets on the facing right-hand leaf (pdf p.31 R, printed p.38), and NOT a maru domain-marker. No domain name is printed anywhere on this leaf. The right-to-left rule consequently has nothing to divide here: the whole leaf sits inside a single domain block. That block is 足守藩, which opens with ○足守藩 on pdf p.30 L and runs through p.33 R before ○赤穂藩 opens on p.33 L. The running header at x=958-1017 reads 藩制一覽表第六（足守）, agreeing with the data for once. owner_domain_jp = 足守藩 on every box.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
(1) x=2656-2743, y=1258-2491: 永四百六十壹貫二百八十五文五分. Unlabelled, because it is the tail of a value begun on the facing leaf: p.31 R ends with 五ヶ年平均／正租／現米千八百八拾石壹斗二升八合四勺 for the domain's 岩代國信夫郡 holding, and this is that land tax's cash half. 461.2855 kanmon.
(2) x=2527-2617, y=1005-2322: label 雜税 (y1005-1149) over 永六拾七貫四百七拾四文六分 (y1257-2322). Same Iwashiro block. Single-character zoom at 4x on the final glyph shows 六 with its clear top lid, not 八 and not 九. 67.4746 kanmon.
(3) x=2482-2530, y=1077-1191: small-type 兩國, sitting on the top-right shoulder of the next column. A qualifier, not data.
(4) x=2400-2477, y=1010-2744: ○合高四萬七千九百三十七石九斗一升五合五勺 = 47,937.9155 koku, read with the shoulder note as 兩國合高, the two provinces' combined assessed yield. Sub-units descend 斗>升>合>勺 correctly; the closing glyph zoomed at 2x is 勺, not 才.
(5) x=2264-2344, y=1007-1654: heading 兩國合五ヶ年平均, "both provinces combined, five-year average". It governs the four columns to its left.
(6) x=2124-2218, y=1008-2577: 正租 over 現米壹萬六十二石三斗二升八合二勺 = 10,062.3282 koku. The 十 after 萬 is a plain cross, not 千 — and the arithmetic settles it independently (see below).
(7) x=1991-2077, y=1256-2489: 永四百六十壹貫二百八十五文五分 = 461.2855 kanmon, the cash half of that same 正租.
(8) x=1858-1950, y=1005-2404: 雜税 over 現米壹石六斗九升七合七勺五才 = 1.69775 koku.
(9) x=1729-1809, y=1259-2190: one continuous eleven-glyph run 金百七拾三兩永八拾四文. Glyph pitch is 84.6px and the projection runs put the join between 兩 (ends y1732) and 永 (starts y1762), so I split it into two boxes at y~1747: 金百七拾三兩 = 173 ryo, 永八拾四文 = 84 mon.
(10) x=1592-1676, y=1260-2323: 永六拾七貫四百七拾四文九分. Zoomed at 4x the last glyph is unmistakably 九 (rounded bending leg), against the unmistakable 六 in column (2). 67.4749 kanmon.
(11) x=1461-1545, y=1010-1655: label 兩國正租幷雜税米, no figure beneath it.
(12) x=1356-1418, y=1013-1154: 惣計, in a narrower column (63px vs ~85px elsewhere) and smaller type. It is a "grand total" qualifier printed between the label in (11) and that label's figure in (13).
(13) x=1204-1284, y=1092-2325: 高一萬六十四石二升五合九勺五才 = 10,064.02595 koku.
(14) x=1080-1155, y=1000-1571: label 兩國正税雜税金, and a row projection down the full leaf confirms NOTHING is printed beneath it — the column is empty from y1571 to the bottom margin.
(15) Header x=958-1017, y=1264-1820: 藩制一覽表第六（足守）. (16) Bottom margin x=933-987, y=3074-3245: 三十九, printed page 39 (the facing leaf carries 三十八).

ARITHMETIC NET — all three checks close.
(a) Both-provinces land tax in rice: 8,182.1998 (Bitchu, p.38) + 1,880.1284 (Iwashiro, p.38) = 10,062.3282, exactly column (6). This also proves the disputed 十 is ten, not one thousand.
(b) Grand total in rice: 10,062.3282 + 1.69775 = 10,064.02595, exactly column (13). So columns (11), (12) and (13) read together as one statement, and 惣計 is a qualifier rather than a group heading.
(c) Grand total in cash: 461.2855 + 67.4746 + 173 + 0.084 = 701.8441 ryo (1 kanmon of 永 = 1 ryo). I opened pdf p.32 R to check, and its first column reads 惣計 金七百壹兩三分壹朱永三十壹文六分 = 701 + 13/16 + 0.0316 = 701.8441. Exact.

TWO FINDINGS WORTH RECORDING. First, check (c) closes only with 67.4746; column (10), the both-provinces total, prints 九分 where its single component in column (2) prints 六分. Both glyphs were read at 4x in isolation and they are different characters, so this is a 0.3-mon slip in the printed source, not a transcription error. I record 九分 verbatim and flag it. Second, MASTER's sole row for this leaf, 惣計 金 七百壹兩三分壹朱, is NOT printed on this leaf: only the label 兩國正税雜税金 is here, and the figure sits on the next leaf. The row is a label-here / figure-there split, so nothing on this page contradicts MASTER, but the figure should be attributed to pdf p.32 R.

ONE UNRECONCILED FIGURE. 兩國合高 47,937.9155 does not close against MASTER's p.30 L figures: 30,898.689 (合) + 5,890.88 (外 改高新田) + 11,149.255 (the Iwashiro ○合 on p.31 R) = 47,938.824, a gap of 0.9085 koku. I re-read the whole value at 1.3x and the closing sub-units at 2x and stand by 四萬七千九百三十七石九斗一升五合五勺, so the discrepancy lies in one of the neighbouring leaves' transcriptions rather than here. Flagging it for whoever annotates pdf p.30 L. Separately, 19,749.4335 (the ○合 opening p.31 R) + 11,149.255 = 30,898.6885, which reproduces MASTER's p.30 L 合 exactly — so that pairing is sound and the missing 0.9085 lies somewhere in the 改高新田 line.

GEOMETRY. Boxes are ink-projection extents padded ~10px. Three places are tight by necessity: the shoulder note 兩國 (ink 2482-2530) is wedged between 合高 (ink ends 2477) and the 雜税/永 column (value ink starts 2527), so its box takes 2479-2529 and the 雜税/永 box starts at 2530, clipping ~3px of the value's left edge. An automated pairwise test reports zero box overlaps. One overlay pass was rendered and read; every box proved flush over its glyphs with no clipping and none sitting on whitespace, so no second corrective pass was needed.

The first two columns finish the Iwashiro block — land tax 461.2855 kanmon in cash, miscellaneous tax 67.4746 kanmon — after which a bulleted line gives the two provinces' combined assessed yield as 47,937.9155 koku. Under the heading "both provinces combined, five-year average" the survey then restates the whole tax take: land tax 10,062.3282 koku of rice plus 461.2855 kanmon, miscellaneous tax 1.69775 koku plus 173 ryo, 84 mon and 67.4749 kanmon. The grand total in rice, 10,064.02595 koku, is printed at the left; the matching cash grand total is labelled here but its figure runs over onto the next leaf.

Every printed count reconciles with the names printed under it. 黑石: 大參事 一人 → 1 name; 權大參事 二人 → 2 names; 少參事 一人 → 1 name. 知事 一人 has no name printed, and 權少參事 has 2 names with no count printed — both are as-printed, not misreads. 久留里: 權大參事 六人 → 2 names on the facing leaf + 4 here = 6; 少參事 二人（一人）→ exactly 1 name printed, which is what the parenthetical states.

proposal.page_summary_en: Fascicle 9 of the Hansei ichiran prints each domain's officer roster, and this half-leaf (book page 381) carries the whole of Kuroishi's alongside the tail of Kururi's and the opening line of Kurobane's. The four name columns at the right edge complete Kururi's six acting senior councillors — two were printed on the facing half-leaf, four here (Terada Chūhei, Hirosawa Kichirō, Murata Sōtarō, Shinozaki Ryūzō) — and are followed by Kururi's junior councillorship, printed 二人（一人）, two posts with only one name given, and its acting junior councillor Masuda Rensō. Kuroishi, opened by the ○黑石藩 marker, records one governor (no name printed), one senior councillor (Sasaki Osamu), two acting senior councillors (Karaushi Kosui and Karaushi Tōri), one junior councillor (Osaka Seiitsu) and two acting junior councillors (Sakaki Shigetoshi and Yamazaki Den), then closes with 兵隊未詳 — its troop strength not recorded. Kurobane's block begins at the far left with its own ○ marker and the bare label 知事, its figures continuing on the following half-leaf.

neighbour_domains.evidence: Bands 1-4 (x2178-2650) stand right of the ○黑石藩 marker at x2039-2126, so they belong to the previous domain. ○黑羽藩 marker at x1106-1193, y1351-1892; the only element left of it is the bare office label 知事 (x973-1037, y2353-2499), the first line of Kurobane's entry. MASTER places 黒羽藩's military block on lower_p203_R, the next half-leaf, confirming the block continues there.

PAGE STRUCTURE. Vertical kyujitai type, read right-to-left. Paper block runs x≈60–2640, y≈210–4224 (everything outside is scan frame / binding black and is not boxed). One maru-marker on the page: ○福山藩 at x1568–1657, y1333–1875 (○ y1333–1412, 福 y1441–1521, 山 y1616–1695, 藩 y1791–1875).

RIGHT-TO-LEFT WALK, with ownership set by the marker rule (right of the marker = PREVIOUS domain; left = the marked domain).
(1) x2123–2177, y1251–1809: running head 藩制一覽表第九（福山）. Provenance only, not data.
(2) x1990–2059, y1162–1395: 右常備 — "the foregoing is the standing force". It closes a list that lies to its RIGHT, i.e. on the preceding page, so it is PREVIOUS-domain material.
(3) x1851–1925, y993–1728: 砲兵一隊　五十三人 (五 1418–1475, 十 plain cross 1503–1561, 三 three bars 1587–1641, 人 strokes touching at apex 1671–1728) = 53 men.
(4) same column, x1839–1913, y1924–2988: 步兵十一小隊　七百三十七人 = 737 men. Both crosses are plain 十, not 千.
(5) x1718–1787, y1161–1394: 右豫備 — "the foregoing is the reserve". It closes items (3)+(4), which therefore are the reserve, and it too sits right of the marker.
(6) ○福山藩 marker. Everything from here leftward is 福山藩.
(7) x1449–1520: 知事　一人. (8) x1309–1383: 大參事　二人. (9) x1171–1292: 權大參事　二人 plus a smaller unbracketed 一 (x1240–1290, y1432–1450) printed immediately to the right of 二人. (10) x1034–1110: 少參事　五人. (11) x635–703, y993–1309: 權少參事 — heading with NO count printed. (12) x503–573, y1161–1307: 兵隊. (13) x346–461, y1032–2493: a bracketed column 〔步兵　三小隊　四十八人小隊ニテ二十四小隊〕 — 步兵/三/小/隊 are full-size (glyph heights 52–61 px), everything from 四 on is reduced (40–48 px), i.e. a warichu-grade note; the bracket halves print at y1032–1061 and y2467–2493.
NAME COLUMNS (y≈1995–2575 upper slot, y≈2929–3497 lower slot), aligned one-to-one under the post headings: 大參事 col x1294–1367 = 岡田創 + 三浦岬 (2 = the printed count); 權大參事 col x1160–1231 = 武田平之助 only (1); 少參事 spills across three columns x1025–1099 (大森鏗爾, 川村九十九), x885–962 (倉井忍男, 猶崎新藏), x757–827 (濱野章吉) = 5, matching 五人; 權少參事 col x620–697 = 宮寺保記, 村上半歳.

THE SMALL 一 NEXT TO 權大參事. Its ink is as dark as the neighbouring strokes (min gray 21 vs 21/24), so it is printed, not set-off or a speck; it is 50 px long against 58–65 px for the full-size 一/二 bars, and its left edge (1240) abuts the right edge of the 二人 count (1230). The preceding page lower_p214_left shows the identical device twice — 大參事 三人（四人）and 少參事 七人（五）, small corrective figures set immediately right of the printed count — so this is the same editorial correction, here printed without its parentheses. It corrects 權大參事 二人 to one man, which is exactly the one name (武田平之助) listed under that post. I merged it into the 權大參事 box rather than giving it its own box, because a separate box would have overlapped the heading glyphs by ~5 px.

NEIGHBOUR IDENTIFICATION. The previous-domain material is 福井藩. The preceding page lower_p214_left (printed 四百五, running head 藩制一覽表第九（福井）) ends with 兵隊 / 砲兵一隊 五十三人 / 步兵十一小隊 七百三十七人 — I opened that scan and read the tail at 1.35×–3× to confirm 七百三十七人. So 福井藩's troop entry is stated twice: the standing force closes p405, 右常備 closes it here, then the identical establishment is restated as the reserve and closed by 右豫備. MASTER's 福井藩 row (pdf_page 214 L) reads this as "步兵11小隊737(常備) 砲兵1隊53(豫備)", splitting the two arms across the two labels; the page geometry does not support that split, since 砲兵一隊五十三人 and 步兵十一小隊七百三十七人 sit in ONE column (centres 1888 and 1876) standing between 右常備 and 右豫備.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER assigns 福山藩 兵備 = 士族550 卒族1150 雇卒600 總計2300 (軍艦ナシ 運用船1) to this page. None of those figures is printed here — I swept the whole paper block for ink not covered by my boxes and found only 131 stray pixels, all specks (largest is a single 80-px ink dot at x≈1600, y≈490 in the top margin). What this page carries for 福山藩 is 兵隊 and the bracketed 步兵 note. The 福山藩 block continues onto lower_p215_left (printed 四百七), which has no image in the viewer directory, and that is almost certainly where the 550/1150/600/2300 figures stand. I trusted the scan and did not import MASTER's figures. Incidentally 24 × 48 = 1,152, close to MASTER's 卒族1150, but I make no claim from that.

ARITHMETIC. Post counts against names: 大參事 2 = 2 names ✓; 少參事 5 = 5 names ✓; 權大參事 printed 2, corrected 1 = 1 name ✓; 知事 1 with no name printed; 權少參事 no count printed, 2 names. Warichu: 24 platoons × 48 men = 1,152 men.

GLYPH CHECKS at 5–10×: the unit in 三小隊 is 小 (central hooked vertical with two flanking strokes), not 大 — verified at 9× on a single character, so the note's "3 companies" against "24 platoons" is what the source prints, not a misreading of 三大隊. 六 in 四百六 has its top lid. 人 in every count has strokes touching at the apex. 鏗 = 金 + 臤/土; 猶 = 犭 + 酋 (not 猪); 半 in 村上半歳 has the 丷 top; the last glyph of that name is 歲 (止 top, 戈 sweep), not 藏 (no 艹).

NON-DATA CALL. Personal-name columns carry no measured quantity, so is_data is false for them and field_jp/parsed/unit are omitted; the post counts, the two 福井 troop figures and the two 步兵 platoon figures are the data cells. HI prints no furigana, so the given-name romanizations below are conventional readings, not attested ones.

The troop heading 兵隊 is followed by a bracketed note giving three infantry companies and, reckoned at forty-eight men to a platoon, twenty-four platoons — 1,152 infantry. The printed page number is 406.

SCAN: 3094x4489. Vertical kyujitai movable type, read RIGHT to LEFT. Two maru-markers are printed on the leaf, so three domains own material here.

COLUMN WALK (right to left), with ink-projection column runs measured on x-band 800-2750, y 900-3500:

x2603-2671 "砲兵一隊" and x2466-2535 "大砲四門" (y1263-1575) + "臼砲四門" (y1686-1996) — both sit to the RIGHT of the first maru-marker, so by the right-to-left rule they belong to the PREVIOUS domain, not to 西條. This is the standard fascicle 8/9 pattern in which a domain's military prints after its officials and overflows past the next domain's marker; the artillery company and the gun counts here are the tail of 佐土原藩's military entry. owner_domain_jp=佐土原藩 on those three boxes.

x2321-2409 "○西條藩" (y1350-1897) — marker. Everything to its LEFT until the next marker is 西條藩.
x2198-2266 "知事" (y1267-1415) — office printed alone; no number and no name follow it anywhere down the column (block scan to y3500 is empty below 1415).
x2064-2132 "大參事 … 一員"; x1926-1996 "權大參事 … 三員"; x1793-1863 "少參事 … 一員"; x1657-1724 "權少參事 … 二員". Each column sets the office title at the top (y~1270-1590) and the establishment figure lower (y~1700-1841), so each box spans title-through-figure. Verified 三 (three clean horizontals) vs 二 at single-character zoom.
x1523-1592 "兵五小隊 貳百三十七人" (y1275-2178). Zoomed the two risky glyphs: the character after 百 is 三 (three horizontals, z_san.png) and the final glyph is 人 (strokes touch at the apex, z_nin.png), not 八.

x1382-1467 "○佐伯藩" (y1362-1917) — second marker; everything to its LEFT is 佐伯藩.
x1256-1324 "知事" (y1275-1423) — again office only, nothing below.
x1118-1190 "大參事 … 一員 … 佐久間儀右衞門" (name at y2198-2771).
x982-1055 "權大參事 … 二員 … 間七郎右衞門" (surname 間 at y2201-2260, one blank glyph slot, then 七郎右衞門 y2368-2766).
x1056-1104 "一人" (y1739-1832) — smaller type (人 is 44px tall against 62px for the neighbouring 員), set in its own narrow run. Ownership decided by edge gaps, not by eye: its left edge is 2px off the 權大參事 column's ink and 14px off the 大參事 column's ink, whereas ordinary inter-column gaps on this leaf run 55-70px. I confirmed the convention on lower_p229_right, where the identical small "一人" hugs the right side of 佐伯's 少參事 三員 column with the same 4px/58px signature. So this gloss annotates 權大參事 二員: two posts on the establishment, one man actually named — which is exactly what the column shows, one name under a count of two.

x865-925 carries the running header 藩制一覽表第九（西條、佐伯）(y1279-1970) and, far below, the printed book page 四百三十三 = 433 (y3125-3370). The header is PROVENANCE and names both domains on the leaf.

ARITHMETIC / CROSS-CHECK. 西條's fascicle-9 line 兵五小隊 貳百三十七人 reconciles exactly with MASTER's fascicle-6 breakdown for the same domain (lower p51 R): 兵隊 二小隊 八十五人 + 兵卒部 一小隊 四十六人 + 軽卒部 二小隊 百六人 = 5 platoons and 85+46+106 = 237 persons. Independent confirmation of both the platoon count and the headcount. 西條's councillor establishment is 1+3+1+2 = 7 posts under the 知事. No 男/女 splits, no 合高, no other totals to net on this leaf.

MASTER DISAGREES WITH THE SCAN, and the scan wins. MASTER lists exactly one row for lower_p228_left — 佐伯藩 兵隊 步兵二小隊 人員記セス — and that text is NOT printed anywhere on this leaf. I found it on lower_p229_right (book page 四百三十四, header 藩制一覽表第九（三田、鯖江）), where 佐伯's block continues to the right of ○三田藩 with 少參事 三員 (plus the same 一人 gloss), 權少參事 二人, and then 步兵二小隊 人員記セス. So MASTER's single row for this page is mis-paged by one leaf, and MASTER holds no rows at all for the ten 佐土原/西條 items printed here.

PRIMARY DOMAIN. Element counts tie at seven boxes each (西條: marker + 知事 + four councillor columns + troops; 佐伯: marker + 知事 + two councillor columns + two name columns + the gloss). I set 西條藩 as primary because its entire fascicle-9 record — marker, full slate of offices, troop strength — is contained on this leaf, whereas 佐伯's entry only begins here and runs on to lower_p229_right, and because the header prints 西條 first in reading order.

GEOMETRY. All 19 boxes measured by ink projection (threshold px<120) inside per-element windows, padded 10px and then clamped at the midpoint of the ink gap where padding would collide — only the 權大參事 / 一人 pair needed clamping (1px true gap). Programmatic pairwise overlap test: none. Per-box interior padding report: every side 0-17px, no glyph touching or crossing an edge. One overlay rendered to _final.png and read back; no box clips a glyph, sits on whitespace, or overlaps a neighbour, so no second geometry pass was needed. The faint grey vertical text in the lower middle of the leaf is facing-page bleed-through (much lighter ink) and is deliberately not boxed; likewise the binding-edge black at x<420.

proposal.page_summary_en: Book page 433 of fascicle 9 of the Hansei ichiran, the Dajōkan's 1869-70 survey of the domains, carrying the officials-and-troops entries for three domains in succession. The leaf opens with the tail of Sadowara domain's military return — one artillery company, four field guns and four mortars — then the maru-marker for Saijō domain (Iyo), whose full slate is printed here: a governor, one senior councillor, three acting senior councillors, one junior councillor and two acting junior councillors, with troops of five platoons totalling 237 men. That troop figure reconciles exactly with the fascicle-6 breakdown recorded elsewhere in the survey for the same domain (2 platoons/85 men + 1 platoon/46 men + 2 platoons/106 men). The Saeki domain (Bungo) marker follows, and its entry begins with a governor, one senior councillor (Sakuma Gi'emon) and two acting senior councillorships filled by a single named man, Hazama Shichirōemon, the shortfall recorded in a small interlinear gloss reading 一人.

The facing leaf lower_p228_right (book page 四百三十二, header 藩制一覽表第九（篠山、佐土原）) ends with ○佐土原藩 followed by 步兵四小隊但一隊六十一人内銃手四十人; this artillery run is the continuation of that same military entry overflowing past the next domain's marker.

proposal.reasoning:
FULL-WIDTH INK PROJECTION (x, y300-4200, ink<110) found exactly 16 printed columns plus the binding black at x0-78 and the scan frame at x2636-3095 (neither boxed): 436-523, 576-659, 692-789, 840-924, 974-1062, 1121-1190, 1224-1310, 1354-1451, 1505-1571, 1630-1715, 1752-1848, 1895-1997+2000-2024 (heading plus its marginal marks), 2042-2112, 2162-2242. Separate projections over the heading band (y990-1520), the upper name band (y1960-2620) and the lower name band (y2880-3540) show that headings sit ~13-20 px to the RIGHT of their own name column, so each heading pairs with the name column directly beneath it.

MARU-MARKER. Exactly one: ○三上藩 at x973-1063, y1340-1887 (glyphs verified at 6x: ○, 三, 上, 藩). RIGHT-TO-LEFT RULE: everything at x>1063 is read BEFORE the marker and therefore belongs to the PREVIOUS domain, 峯山藩; everything at x<973 belongs to the marked domain, 三上藩. That puts 兵隊　二小隊 (x1121-1190) on the 峯山 side, matching MASTER's single row for this page and matching the fascicle-8/9 rule that a domain's military prints after its officials and can sit to the right of the next domain's marker.

WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
(1) x2162-2242: the hashira — running head 藩制一覽表第九（三上）(y1270-1833) and, lower, the printed leaf number 四百四十八 = 448 (y3113-3358). Page-number arithmetic checks: the preceding half-leaf lower_p235_left prints 四百四十七 (447) and lower_p237_right prints 四百五十 (450), so 448 is right. The running head is PROVENANCE and names only 三上, the domain whose entry OPENS here; the leaf's bulk is 峯山's.
(2) x2042-2112, upper slot only: 柴崎七郎兵衞. No heading above it. The preceding half-leaf (lower_p235_left) heads 峰山藩's 權大參事　二人（五人）— printed 2, editorially corrected to 5 — and lists four names there (今井多門, 高木內藏進, 佐藤榮, 辻八太郎). 柴崎七郎兵衞 is the FIFTH, completing that group; its lower slot is empty because the group ends.
(3) x1929-2025 heading 少參事　二人 with two half-width marks (a マ wedge over a ヽ dot) printed in the right margin beside 二. Cropped side by side against lower_p235_left's 少參事　二人（マヽ）at the same scale, these are the same マヽ ("sic") marks, here without the enclosing parenthesis arcs. The heading is flagged because the printed figure is wrong: SEVEN names stand under it, running column-wise right to left, upper slot then lower slot — 齋藤多仲 / 秋山瀨織 (x1900/1884), 石根源五郎 / 塚田六郎 (x1766/1750), 米澤七郎 / 川口克巳 (x1634/1620), 井田耕造 (x1494, upper only). Same editorial pattern as akita_lower_p220_left (少參事　二人（六人）with six names).
(4) x1385-1452 heading 權少參事, no count printed (313 px tall = 4 glyphs only), with four names: 長谷川久一郎 / 田中小十郎 (x1361/1343), 槇秀尾 / 長谷川薰 (x1225/1213).
(5) x1121-1190: 兵隊　二小隊, y1006-1483. Two companies, no headcount printed — agrees with MASTER exactly.
(6) x973-1063: the ○三上藩 marker.
(7) Left of the marker, 三上藩 opens with four office headings, each with its names in the same column: 大參事 (x854-925) / 粥川小十郎; 權大參事 (x721-789) / 神山雪江 (upper), 塚本九一郎 (lower); 少參事 (x592-660) / 水谷榮三郎; 權少參事 (x454-524) / 餌取傳. None of the four headings prints a person-count (heading heights 229-315 px = 3 or 4 glyphs, no trailing 〇人).

GLYPH CHECKS at 6x, single character: 瀨 and 織 in 秋山瀨織 (糸 radical with 音 over 戈 — not 繼, which would show stacked 幺); 巳 in 川口克巳 (closed top, not 己/已); 六 in 塚田六郎 (top dot + lid, not 八); 十 in 粥川小十郎 and 田中小十郎 (plain cross, no slanted top stroke — not 千); 九 in 塚本九一郎 (rounded bending leg, not 七); 七 in 柴崎七郎兵衞 and 米澤七郎; 八 in 四百四十八 (strokes separate at the top). 槇秀尾 and 餌取傳 confirmed. An isolated ink speck at x1752-1770, y2695-2715 (below 石根源五郎) is a stray mark, not a glyph, and is not boxed; faint facing-page bleed-through on the left third is likewise not boxed.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER carries ONE row for this page — 峯山藩 兵隊 二小隊, no headcount — which the scan confirms verbatim. The scan does not contradict MASTER anywhere. But MASTER holds nothing else from this leaf: the twelve 峯山 personal names, the three 峯山 headings, and the entire 三上藩 block (marker, four headings, five names) are absent, and MASTER has no 三上藩 rows at all. So 三上藩 is an un-extracted domain in the dataset, and 26 of the 27 elements here are new.

NAMING. 峯山藩's own name is not printed anywhere on this half-leaf — its marker stands on the preceding leaf, where fascicle 9 prints it ○峰山藩 (with 峰); fascicle 7 (pdf p.75) prints ○峯山藩, which is the MASTER key and the form used for owner_domain_jp here.

GEOMETRY. Each box was cut by ink projection inside a generous window (threshold <115) and padded 10 px. A pairwise overlap test over all 27 boxes reported none. One overlay pass was rendered and read: every box encloses its full glyph run top-to-bottom with no clipping, no dead margin and no box sitting on whitespace, so no corrective second pass was needed.
proposal.page_header_en: Domain Survey (藩制一覧表), Fascicle 9 — running head names Mikami (三上藩); the leaf carries the tail of Mineyama's (峯山藩) officials roster and the opening of Mikami's
proposal.page_summary_en: This fascicle-9 half-leaf, printed page 448, carries the tail of Mineyama Domain's (峯山藩) officials roster and the opening of Mikami Domain's (三上藩), the two separated by the ○三上藩 marker at x973-1063. Twelve Mineyama names stand to the right of that marker: Shibasaki Shichirobē, the fifth acting senior councillor (權大參事) of a group whose heading and first four names print on the preceding leaf; seven junior councillors (少參事) under a heading that prints 二人 with the 1928 editor's マヽ "sic" marks beside the figure; and four acting junior councillors (權少參事) under a heading with no count printed. Mineyama's military line closes its entry with 兵隊　二小隊 — two companies, no headcount given — the one element of this page already held in MASTER. Left of the marker, Mikami's entry opens with one senior councillor (粥川小十郎), two acting senior councillors (神山雪江 and 塚本九一郎), one junior councillor (水谷榮三郎) and one acting junior councillor (餌取傳), none of the four headings carrying a printed person-count.

neighbour_domains.evidence: Everything at x>1063 sits to the right of the ○三上藩 marker (x973-1063) and is therefore read first, belonging to the previous domain: the 少參事 heading at x1929-2025, the 權少參事 heading at x1385-1452, the 兵隊　二小隊 line at x1121-1190, and twelve personal names from x1213 to x2124. The entry continues from lower_p235_left, whose ○峰山藩 marker and 權大參事　二人（五人）heading account for 柴崎七郎兵衞 as that office's fifth holder.

The ○三上藩 marker at xywh=pixel:963,1330,110,567 opens this domain; everything at x<973 lies left of it — four office headings (大參事 x844, 權大參事 x711, 少參事 x582, 權少參事 x444) and five personal names beneath them. The running head 藩制一覽表第九（三上）names this domain as the one whose entry begins on the leaf.

proposal.reasoning:
RENDER AND OVERALL SHAPE. Scan is 3094x4489. Ink-projection over the paper interior gives 14 vertical glyph runs between x=835 and x=2674, plus a top "office title" register (y≈1030-1375), three "name" registers, and an outer-margin column at x≈835-932 carrying the running header at top and the printed page number at foot. This is a fascicle-9 (officials) leaf; there is no military section anywhere on it.

MARU-MARKERS AND THE RIGHT-TO-LEFT RULE. Two markers: ○三池藩 at x2448-2539 (y1390-1935) and ○靜岡藩 at x1622-1716 (y1380-1923). Reading right to left: everything RIGHT of ○三池藩 (the single column at x2555-2674: 權少參事 + 石渡森衞 + 尾崎彌一郎) belongs to the PREVIOUS domain. That previous domain is 三草藩 (Mikusa): the facing leaf lower_p237_right carries the running header 藩制一覽表第九（峯岡、三草）and its leftmost column is Mikusa's 少參事 running on to this leaf, so the acting-junior-councillor column here is Mikusa's tail. Between the two markers (x1728-2420) is 三池藩; LEFT of ○靜岡藩 (x838-1598) is 靜岡藩.

BOOK-PAGE ORDER. The bottom margin prints 四百五十一 = 451; the facing right-hand leaf prints 四百五十 = 450, confirming p237_right is read first and this leaf second, and confirming Mikusa spills onto it.

COLUMN-BY-COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
COL1 x2555-2674 — 三草藩: title 權少參事 (y1049-1371); names 石渡森衞 (y2057-2643) and 尾崎彌一郎 (y2979-3565).
COL2 x2448-2539 — ○三池藩 marker.
COL3 x2304-2420 — 三池藩: title 大小參事 (x2310-2378, y1051-1362) with the count 七人 (x2304-2366, y1451-1690) and, in the gutter immediately right of the figure, a small-type parenthetical at x2369-2420. Zoomed to 9x, the parenthetical row-runs are （ 1451-1468 | one horizontal 1489-1498 | two horizontals 1526-1534 + 1553-1560 | 八 1576-1616 | 人 1626-1668 | ） 1673-1690, i.e. （一二八人）= 128 persons, in the 1928 editor's digit-sequence style.
COL4 x2128-2251 — 大參事; name 屋山外記; second name 庵原覺平.
COL5 x1992-2115 — 權大參事; names 佐野三郎治 and 森脩, with the small rider 公議人 at x2072-2124.
COL6 x1861-1984 — 少參事; names 立花碩 and 吉村土肥.
COL7 x1728-1851 — 權少參事; names 中島裕 and 堀七右衞門.
COL8 x1622-1716 — ○靜岡藩 marker.
COL9 x1515-1598 — 大參事; one name 平岡丹治.
COL10 x1345-1465 — 權大參事; 淺野次郎八, 服部綾雄, 河野九郎.
COL11 x1210-1324 — no title of its own, so it continues 權大參事: 織田泉三, 富永雄造, 戸川平太.
COL12 x1076-1189 — no title, continues 權大參事: 大久保一翁, 山岡鐵太郎, 妻木務, the last carrying the 公議人 rider at x1156-1206.
COL13 x948-1070 — 少參事; 松平寛太郎, 津田眞一郎, 岩田綠堂.
COL14 x835-932 — outer margin: running header 藩制一覽表第九（三池、靜岡）(y1290-1977) and printed page number 四百五十一 (x835-886, y3134-3364).

ARITHMETIC CHECK. Miike's summary line prints 七人 (7 persons) for 大小參事, and exactly seven men are named beneath it across COL4-COL7 (1 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 7). The count reconciles. The small parenthetical （一二八人）= 128 therefore cannot be an editorial correction of the councillor count (the pattern seen elsewhere in this reprint, e.g. 少參事 二人（六人）on lower_p220_left); on the evidence of the page alone its referent is undetermined, and I have recorded it verbatim inside the same box rather than parsing it. The Miike attribution is independently corroborated by one of the named junior councillors, 立花碩: Tachibana is the ruling house of Miike.

RIDER ATTRIBUTION. Both 公議人 riders are set in small type, raised about 130 px above the name register and placed in the gutter to the RIGHT of a name column — the corpus convention (cf. hasunoike_lower_p133_right, "printed to the right of Nagata Yūsuke"). The Miike rider at x2072-2124 therefore labels 森脩 in COL5 (x1992-2068), not 庵原覺平 in COL4 (x2128-2206); the Shizuoka rider at x1156-1206 labels 妻木務 in COL12 (x1076-1149), not 戸川平太 in COL11 (x1210-1279). Horizontal profiles over y2940-3060 confirm the three-way separation on each side: (2006-2068 | 2074-2124 | 2140-2206) and (1091-1149 | 1158-1206 | 1223-1279).

LOOK-ALIKE AND VARIANT CHECKS. COL3's second glyph is 小 (plain three-stroke) not 少 — compared side by side with the 少 of COL6/COL13 in the title register, which carries the extra falling stroke. Single-glyph zooms at 7x settled 寛 (in 松平寛太郎; the 宀 sits directly on the 見-form element, no 艹), 脩 (in 森脩), 衞 (kyujitai, in 石渡森衞) and 外 (in 屋山外記). A 3x montage settled 吉村土肥, 平岡丹治, 織田泉三, 戸川平太, 妻木務, 岩田綠堂 and 尾崎彌一郎.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER carries one row for this page, 静岡藩 兵隊 "(NO military line; large officer corps only)". The scan agrees: there is no 兵隊 / 銃兵 / 炮兵 line anywhere on the leaf, and Shizuoka's entry is officials only and continues onto the next leaf. MASTER has no row at all for 三池藩 here, although Miike's complete councillor establishment — the 七人 summary plus seven named men — is printed on this leaf; that is a gap in MASTER, not a disagreement.

WHAT I DID NOT BOX. No stray ink survived checking: the projection hits at x2165-2225 and x1785-1800 inside the first name register turned out to be the top few rows of 屋 and 中 protruding into the window, not separate marks. No bleed-through, binding-edge or frame ink was boxed.

GEOMETRY. All 38 boxes were cut by ink projection inside per-element windows drawn from the band profiles, padded 10 px, with the pad reduced to 0-3 px where a 公議人 rider sits within a few pixels of the neighbouring name column. A pairwise test reports zero overlaps. Two overlay passes were rendered to _final.png; the first showed two 2-px collisions (rider vs neighbouring name on each side), which were corrected, and the second confirmed every box is flush — label glyph through last value glyph, no clipped strokes, no box on whitespace.

proposal.page_header_en: Hansei ichiran-hyō, Fascicle 9 (Miike, Shizuoka) — the officials-and-military fascicle of the 1869-70 Dajōkan domain survey. The header names the domains whose entries open on this leaf, not every domain printed on it: Mikusa's tail also runs across the right-hand edge.
proposal.page_topic: Fascicle-9 domain officials: Miike's whole councillor roster and the opening of Shizuoka's
proposal.page_summary_en: Printed page 451 of fascicle 9, an officials leaf with no military section. It opens on the right with the tail of Mikusa domain — one 權少參事 column carrying Ishiwata Mori'e and Ozaki Yaichirō — after which the ○三池藩 marker introduces Miike's complete councillor establishment: a summary line 大小參事 七人 (senior and junior councillors, 7 persons) followed by one senior councillor, two acting senior councillors, two junior councillors and two acting junior councillors, seven named men that reconcile exactly with the printed figure; a small-type （一二八人）, 128 persons, stands in the gutter beside it and cannot be a correction to that count. The ○靜岡藩 marker then opens the Tokugawa house's Shizuoka domain with thirteen men in three grades: one senior councillor (Hiraoka Tanji), nine acting senior councillors including Ōkubo Ichiō, Yamaoka Tetsutarō (Tesshū) and the kōgi-nin Tsumaki Tsutomu, and three junior councillors including Tsuda Shin'ichirō, the later jurist Tsuda Mamichi. Shizuoka's entry prints no troop line and runs on to the next leaf.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The single column at x2555-2674 (title 權少參事, names 石渡森衞 and 尾崎彌一郎) stands to the RIGHT of the ○三池藩 marker at x2448-2539, so it belongs to the preceding domain. That domain is Mikusa: the facing leaf lower_p237_right runs the header 藩制一覽表第九（峯岡、三草）and ends with Mikusa's 少參事 column, which continues here.

Miike's five columns (x1728-2420) stand to the RIGHT of the ○靜岡藩 marker at x1622-1716 and to the LEFT of its own ○三池藩 marker at x2448-2539. Its block is complete on this leaf: 大小參事 七人 plus seven named men. The junior councillor 立花碩 bears the surname of Miike's ruling house.

proposal.reasoning:
SCAN GEOMETRY. Native 3095x4489. Scan furniture excluded: black binding strip x<95, black frame rows y<225 and y>4240, and the black band x>2660. Real print block is x 459-2258, y 971-3480.

MARU-MARKERS. Ink-projection over x 60-2600 (y 300-4200) gives 14 content columns plus the binding edge. Exactly two maru-markers are printed: ○下妻藩 at x 1394-1484 (circle y 1319-1397, 下 y 1435-1507, 妻 y 1608-1689, 藩 y 1782-1865) and ○志筑藩 at x 590-677 (circle y 1311-1389, 志 1424-1501, 筑 1594-1674, 藩 1774-1856). Right-to-left rule applied: everything RIGHT of ○下妻藩 (x >= 1525) is read earlier and belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything between the two markers belongs to 下妻藩; everything LEFT of ○志筑藩 belongs to 志筑藩.

WHO IS THE PREVIOUS DOMAIN. The printed page number in the outer (right) margin reads 四百五十八 = 458 (third glyph zoomed at 4x: the closed Z-form 五, not 九). The preceding leaf image lower_p240_left carries 四百五十七 = 457, so 457 and 458 are consecutive. lower_p240_left ends with the ○芝山藩 marker followed by a single column 大參事 / 甲賀秀實 / 福島佳一 / 國非誠一 and no further marker. Therefore the un-marked officials columns filling the right half of this page continue 芝山藩's block. The running head 藩制一覧表第九（下妻、志筑）names only the two domains whose entries START on this leaf; it is provenance, and it does NOT name 芝山藩 even though 芝山藩 owns five of the columns here.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (native x; y-runs from per-column row projection).
1. x 2200-2258, y 1243-1931: running head 藩制一覧表第九（下妻、志筑）, small type. Not data.
   x 2181-2231, y 3086-3328: printed page number 四百五十八. Not data.
2. x 2046-2142: title 權大參事 (y 986-1299) then three names at the three standard name bands - 里見莊兵衞 (5 glyphs, y 1407-1971), 濱野廣多 (y 2158-2725), 靑木省三 (y 2912-3475). Owner 芝山藩.
3. x 1915-2004: NO title; three names at the identical bands - 赤岸兵藏 (y 1400-1969), 靑木源衞 (y 2156-2724), 川副勝記 (y 2912-3479). An untitled column at the same bands is the overflow of the office titled in the column to its right, so this is the second column of 權大參事 (six holders in all). Owner 芝山藩.
4. x 1783-1877: title 少參事 (y 986-1215) then 山岸左曹 (y 1403-1972), 久松小彌多 (5 glyphs, y 2159-2725), 土屋宗 (y 2916-3477). The third name has only three glyphs; the bottom glyph 宗 bottom-aligns at y 3477 with the last glyph of every neighbouring name column (3474/3479/3480/3480), so nothing is missing - it is a two-glyph surname plus a one-glyph given name. Owner 芝山藩.
5. x 1653-1740: NO title; 佐竹義衞 (y 1402-1970), 川副審人 (y 2158-2726), 四宮尚義 (y 2919-3480). Second column of 少參事. Owner 芝山藩.
6. x 1525-1612: title 權少參事 (y 985-1296) then 山角嘉善 (y 1402-1971) and 近藤琢磨 (y 2160-2729); the third band is empty (row projection finds no ink below y 2729 in this column). Two holders. Owner 芝山藩.
7. x 1394-1484: ○下妻藩 marker.
8. x 1272-1343: 大參事 (y 982-1212) 一人 (y 1425-1546). Owner 下妻藩.
9. x 1137-1207: 權大參事 (y 980-1295) 二人 (y 1409-1545).
10. x 1003-1071: 少參事 (y 982-1208) 二人 (y 1410-1543).
11. x 869-937: 權少參事 (y 978-1293) 三人 (y 1403-1542).
12. x 736-804: 兵隊 (y 976-1125) 一小隊 (一 y 1256-1266, 小隊 y 1319-1462). No headcount is printed - the entry stops at the formation. This column stands to the RIGHT of the ○志筑藩 marker, the fascicle-8/9 military-overflow pattern, so it belongs to 下妻藩, not 志筑藩.
13. x 590-677: ○志筑藩 marker.
14. x 469-538: 大參事 (y 971-1203) 貳員 (y 1388-1535). 貳 = 2, and 員 is used here where the 下妻 columns use 人. Owner 志筑藩.
A single 8x10 px speck at x 562-570 was rejected as scan dirt, not ink.

ARITHMETIC / CROSS-CHECK. No koku, cash, weight or demographic totals are printed on this page, so the sum nets do not apply; the only numbers are headcounts (1, 2, 2, 3 for 下妻藩's four councillor grades; 2 for 志筑藩's 大參事) and one formation (一小隊). 下妻藩's printed counts (1+2+2+3 = 8 councillors) are counts only - no names are printed for 下妻藩 - while 芝山藩's continuation columns are names only, with no counts. That asymmetry is in the source, not a transcription slip.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER carries exactly one row for this page, 下妻藩 兵隊 = 一小隊 with no headcount. The scan agrees. MASTER is silent on the other fourteen boxes (下妻藩's four councillor counts, both maru-markers, 志筑藩's 大參事 貳員, 芝山藩's five name columns, the running head and the page number), so this page is heavily under-extracted in MASTER rather than wrong.

BOXES. Each box is the tight ink bbox of one printed column over its own y-range, padded 10 px. Smallest horizontal gap between neighbouring boxes is 18 px (x 1887 to 1905), so no box overlaps another. The running-head box and the page-number box share the same column but are separated vertically by 1,135 px.

proposal.page_summary_en: A fascicle-9 officials page carrying the end of Shibayama domain's roster, the whole of Shimotsuma domain's entry, and the opening of Shizuku domain's. Shibayama's councillors are given by name with no counts: six provisional senior councillors (Satomi Shōbee, Hamano Hirota, Aoki Shōzō, Akagishi Hyōzō, Aoki Genee, Kawazoe Shōki), six junior councillors (Yamagishi Sazō, Hisamatsu Koyata, Tsuchiya Sō, Satake Yoshiee, Kawazoe Shinhito, Shinomiya Naoyoshi), and two provisional junior councillors (Yamazumi Kayoshi, Kondō Takuma). Shimotsuma reports the opposite way — counts with no names: one senior councillor, two provisional senior councillors, two junior councillors, three provisional junior councillors, eight in all, plus a military entry of one platoon with no headcount printed. Shizuku's entry begins with two senior councillors, written 貳員.

neighbour_domains.evidence: Five untitled/titled officials name columns fill x 1525-2142, all to the right of the maru-marker ○下妻藩 at x 1394-1484, so by the right-to-left rule they belong to the previous domain. The ○志筑藩 maru-marker sits at x 590-677; the only column to its left is 大參事 貳員 at x 469-538. The 兵隊 一小隊 column at x 736-804 lies to the RIGHT of this marker and is therefore Shimotsuma's military overflow, not Shizuku's.

proposal.reasoning:
RENDER + COLUMN WALK. Native scan 3094x4489; page (non-frame) area x445-3093, y220-4237. One ink-projection over the whole text field returned 14 vertical glyph runs, which I walked RIGHT to LEFT (HI reads right-to-left, top-to-bottom):

C1 x2562-2655 = maru-marker ○弘前藩 (4 glyph runs, y1378-1921).
C2 x2416-2514 = 大參事 / 二人, with 西館融 (upper name register) and 山中純一 (lower register).
C3 x2279-2378 = 權大參事 / 三人, names 杉山龍江 (upper), 大道寺族 (lower).
C4 x2161-2230 = name-only column, 西館孤清 (upper register, no lower name).
C5 x2017-2112 = 少參事 / 四人, names 山野茂樹 (upper), 楠美太素 (lower).
C6 x1885-1967 = name-only column, 佐藤清衞 (upper), 岩淵惟一 (lower).
C7 x1750-1852 = 權少參事 / 四人, names 神東太郎 (upper), 都谷森逸眠 (lower).
C8 x1617-1698 = name-only column, 小山巴 (upper), 櫻庭太次馬 (lower).
C9 x1481-1596 = 兵隊 heading over a two-register warichu: right half 兵士 …人, left half 兵卒 …人.
C10 x1360-1450 = maru-marker ○彦根藩.
C11 x1223-1316 = 大參事 / 一人, name 新野古拙.
C12 x1076-1180 = 權大參事 / 三人, names 木俣幹 (upper), 田中央 (lower).
C13 x961-1032 = name-only column, 西村拾三.
C14 x832-915 = running header 藩制一覧表第九（弘前、彦根） (y1296-1984) and, far below it, the printed page number 四百六十一 (y3139-3378).

DOMAIN BOUNDARY. Two maru-markers. Nothing is printed to the RIGHT of ○弘前藩 (the projection finds no ink beyond x2655 except the scan-edge artifact at x3079-3090), so no previous domain overflows onto this leaf; 弘前藩's block starts here. Everything from ○弘前藩 leftward up to — but not including — ○彦根藩 is 弘前藩: the four councillor grades, all thirteen names, and the 兵隊 group. The 兵隊/兵士/兵卒 column sits immediately to the RIGHT of the ○彦根藩 marker, which by the right-of-marker rule (and the fascicle-8/9 habit of printing a domain's military after its officials) makes it 弘前藩's, not 彦根's. That agrees with MASTER, which files this military row under 弘前藩. Everything LEFT of ○彦根藩 — 大參事 一人 新野古拙, 權大參事 三人 木俣幹/田中央/西村拾三 — is 彦根藩, whose block continues onto the next leaf. The running header and the page number sit in the far-left margin and are page furniture (provenance), not domain data; the header names both domains printed on this leaf.

HEADCOUNT ARITHMETIC. Stated counts 2+3+4+4 = 13. Name boxes: C2 gives 2 (=大參事), C3+C4 give 3 (=權大參事: 杉山龍江, 大道寺族, 西館孤清), C5+C6 give 4 (=少參事: 山野茂樹, 楠美太素, 佐藤清衞, 岩淵惟一), C7+C8 give 4 (=權少參事: 神東太郎, 都谷森逸眠, 小山巴, 櫻庭太次馬). 13 names for 13 posts — the counts and the name columns reconcile exactly, which is what fixes each name to its grade. Hikone: 1 + 3 = 4 names present (新野古拙; 木俣幹, 田中央, 西村拾三) ✓.

MASTER DISAGREEMENT — TRUST THE SCAN. MASTER records 弘前藩 兵備 as 兵士 貳千五百五十七人 (2,557) 兵卒 千四百四十九人. Separate row-projections of the two warichu halves give the right (兵士) half exactly SIX number glyphs (y1587-1978) and the left (兵卒) half SEVEN (y1590-2050). Cropped one glyph at a time at 5x, the 兵士 run is 貳 / 千 / 五 / 十 / 七 / 人 — there is no 百 between 五 and 十. So the page reads 兵士 貳千五十七人 = 2,057, and MASTER's 2,557 carries a phantom 百 (the documented M7 error mode). 兵卒 is confirmed 千四百四十九人 = 1,449 (千/四/百/四/十/九/人, seven glyphs). Total force on the page = 3,506 men.

GLYPH CHECKS at 5-7x, single character: 族 (大道寺族, 方+矢 clear), 眠 (都谷森逸眠, 目+民 — distinct from the 馬 that ends 櫻庭太次馬), 孤 (西館孤清, 子+瓜), 衞 (佐藤清衞, kyujitai), 惟 (岩淵惟一). 參 is printed in the kyujitai form 厽+彡 throughout, so all four office titles are transcribed 參 not 参. The counts 二人/三人/四人 and 一人 were read from a 1.6-2.2x crop of the whole label band; every 人 shows the two strokes touching at the apex (not 八).

BOXES. Each box was measured by thresholding px<120 inside a generous region and taking the tight ink bbox, then padding 9px; label glyphs and their value are enclosed together (e.g. 大參事+二人 in one box), and each personal name is its own box since the upper and lower registers are different men. The 兵士/兵卒 pair share one top at the sub-label row (y1373) and are split at the true ink boundary (兵卒 ink ends x1539, 兵士 ink begins x1541) so they abut without overlapping; the centred 兵隊 heading is a separate box above both. A pairwise test over all 30 boxes reports zero overlaps. One overlay pass was rendered to _final.png and read back: every box encloses its glyphs, none clips a stroke or sits on whitespace. Faint facing-page bleed-through around x1150-1250 in the lower third is correctly left unboxed.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKER SEARCH FIRST. I projected ink across the whole leaf (threshold <100/<110, noise floor ~74 from paper texture and facing-page bleed). Real text occupies x=379..2210 only; there is no ink at all between x=2210 and the black binding edge at x~2580, and nothing left of x=379 except one 9x8px speck at (259,2944) which I did not box. There is NO maru-marker (circle + name + 藩) anywhere on this leaf. The right-to-left rule therefore has nothing to divide: this is a continuation leaf entirely inside one domain's block, and every box carries owner_domain_jp = 飯田藩. The running header at the far right reads 藩制一覽表第一（飯田）, which is provenance (fascicle 1, Iida) and here agrees with the data. MASTER's single row for this page (飯田藩 人口 26,580) also agrees, and my own reading of that column confirms it glyph by glyph.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (16 ink columns detected, several of which are warichu halves):
1. x2134-2210: running header 藩制一覽表第一（飯田）, and lower in the same right margin the printed book-page number 三十八 (=38) at y3179-3320.
2. x1991-2109: the column heading 甲子ヨリ／戊辰マテ (two small side-by-side runs) over 五ヶ年平均 — "five-year average, Kōshi (1864) through Boshin (1868)". It heads the four rice columns that follow.
3. x1863-1946: 正租米九千百九拾壹石七斗三升七合壹勺 = 9,191.7371 koku.
4. x1734-1814: 雜租米百貳拾三石壹斗四升壹合四勺四才 = 123.14144 koku.
5. x1600-1680: 雜税米七百貳拾三石六斗貳升八合四勺八才 = 723.62848 koku.
6. x1476-1554: 合現米壹萬〇〇三拾八石五斗〇七合〇貳才 = 10,038.50702 koku.
ARITHMETIC NET: 9,191.7371 + 123.14144 + 723.62848 = 10,038.50702 exactly. The three components reconcile to the printed total to the 才 place, so every sub-koku unit is confirmed (all strictly descending 石>斗>升>合>勺>才, with 升 and 勺 skipped as zero in the total, printed 〇).
7. Small-type marginal note above the demographic columns, y704-977, four half-width columns plus a label: 巳年調ヘ (x1421-1466) / 五千七百二 (x1369-1416) / 十二戸 (x1318-1365) / 二萬六千四 (x1266-1313) / 百十八人 (x1215-1262). Read in warichu order this is 巳年調ヘ 五千七百二十二戸 二萬六千四百十八人 — the snake-year (1869) count: 5,722 households, 26,418 persons. I boxed the label separately from the two numbers so each value gets its own data box.
8. x1341-1433: 戸數 五千七百七十戸 = 5,770 households, followed lower in the same column by the parenthetical （但シ午年調）— "surveyed in the horse year (1870)". The two survey years are consistent: the main figures are 1870, the marginal note is 1869.
9. x1191-1296: 人口 貳萬六千五百八十人 = 26,580, then the structural 内 (unboxed, y2081-2127), then the sex split in two side-by-side runs sharing the top row at y~2142. LEFT = 女壹萬三千百九拾七人 (13,197), RIGHT = 男壹萬三千三百八十三人 (13,383). 13,383 + 13,197 = 26,580 exactly.
10. x1049-1160: 神社 四拾九社 (49 shrines); then （社人戸數十一戸 (11 shrine-attendant households); then the label 人口; then LEFT 女十九人 (19), RIGHT 男廿三人 (23) — 42 people in 11 households. Note 廿 = 20.

I zoomed this pair to 5x at single-character level because the low-resolution reading suggested the reverse assignment; the 男/女 header row settles it: 女 sits left, 男 right, so the sixteen are women and the eleven men.
12. x803-892: 寺 五拾二ヶ寺 (52 temples), then the breakdown （内 寺三十六 塔中十二 尼四軒）printed as three stacked groups in the same column. ARITHMETIC: 36 + 12 + 4 = 52, so the breakdown reconciles to the total.
13. x654-772: 人口 百六拾七人 (167, the temple population), 内, then LEFT 女三十壹人（内尼五人）(31, of whom 5 nuns), RIGHT 男百三十六人 (136). 136 + 31 = 167.
14. x513-628: 士族戸數 貳百八軒 (208 houses); 人口 千七拾五人 (1,075); 内; LEFT 女五百四十九人 (549), RIGHT 男五百貳十六人 (526). 526 + 549 = 1,075. I re-zoomed this pair at 5x as well, because 四/貳 and 九/六 sit in the same slots on the two runs; the left run reads 五百四十九 and the right 五百貳十六, i.e. women outnumber men among the shizoku here.
15. x379-493: 卒族戸數 百三拾軒 (130 houses); 人口 五百〇四人 (504); 内; LEFT 女貳百五十四人 (254), RIGHT 男貳百五十人 (250). 250 + 254 = 504.

GLYPH CAUTIONS APPLIED: checked 十 vs 千 on every thousands place (正租米九千, 戸數五千七百七十, 人口壹萬三千…) at single-character zoom — all the 千 carry the slanted top stroke; 人 vs 八 distinguished by the touching apex on every counter glyph; 六 vs 八 by the top lid (寺人口百三十六人, 山伏女十六口); 貳 read as 2 throughout; the 〇 in 五百〇四人 and in 壹萬〇〇三拾八石 are printed circles, not punctuation.

GEOMETRY: every box measured by ink projection (threshold 110, pad ~10) and checked programmatically for pairwise overlap — zero overlaps across all 39 boxes. proposal.page_summary_en: This leaf continues the fascicle-1 return for Iida domain in Shinano, with no domain marker on the page: every figure belongs to Iida. The right-hand block gives the five-year average tax rice for 1864 through 1868 — regular land tax 9,191.7371 koku, miscellaneous land rent 123.14144 koku, and miscellaneous imposts 723.62848 koku, summing exactly to the printed total of 10,038.50702 koku of actual rice. The demographic block records 5,770 households and 26,580 people in the horse-year (1870) count, split 13,383 men and 13,197 women, with a marginal note giving the snake-year (1869) figures of 5,722 households and 26,418 people. The religious and status counts follow: 49 shrines with 11 attendant households (23 men, 19 women), 8 yamabushi households (11 men, 16 women), 52 temples broken down as 36 temples, 12 sub-temples and 4 nunneries with 167 residents (136 men, 31 women including 5 nuns), 208 shizoku houses holding 1,075 people, and 130 sotsu houses holding 504.

SCAN 3094x4551. Ink-projection over x700-2800 / y800-3800 gives exactly 15 vertical glyph runs (plus a lone 内 at x2726-2769, y1078-1126). Reading RIGHT to LEFT:

(1) x2726-2769: the lone structural 内 ("of which") introducing the status breakdown — NOT boxed per instruction. (2) x2606-2718: 士族戸數 三百七十軒, then 同人口 二千九百二十七人, then the 内 split as two side-by-side runs sharing top y=3012 (女 LEFT x2605-2659 = 千五百三十二人; 男 RIGHT x2661-2711 = 千三百九十五人). (3) x2475-2585: 卒族戸數 二百軒, 同人口 千四十一人, split 女 五百八人 / 男 五百三十三人 (valley measured at x=2525; female ink stops at y2910, male runs to y3048 — the earlier merged run was male 人 splaying left of the valley). (4) x2350-2451: 穢多人口 五十四人, split 女 二十七人 / 男 二十七人 (valley x=2401). (5) x2246-2320: 神社 百三十社. (6) x2091-2184: three label+value pairs stacked in one column — 寺 五拾三ヶ寺, 宿寺 三ヶ所, 庵 拾九ヶ所. (7) x1979-2055: 村數 八拾三ヶ所. (8) x1824-1916: 兵隊一大隊 四百六十二人, 大砲隊 八十五人.

(9) x1690-1780, y1421-1969: the ONLY maru-marker on the leaf, ○伯太藩. RIGHT-TO-LEFT RULE: everything in columns (1)-(8), which stands to the RIGHT of this marker, was read BEFORE the marker and therefore closes the PREVIOUS domain's entry; everything to the LEFT opens 伯太藩. The previous domain is 八戸藩: MASTER records 八戸藩 on this same pdf_page with 草高 四萬七十四石, 戸數 壹萬三千三百八十六軒, 人口 六萬七千六百四十七人, and with the very values I read here (兵隊一大隊 四百六十二人, 寺 五拾三ヶ寺, 神社 百三十社), the entry having opened at book p.53 under a running header reading (八戸). So owner_domain_jp = 八戸藩 for all eighteen boxes right of the marker.

(10) x1557-1639: 草高 壹萬四千貳百七十三石三升四合壹勺 = 14,273.0341 — character-for-character identical to MASTER's row for this page. (11) x1435-1509: 本高 壹萬三千五百廿石 = 13,520 (廿 = 20). (12) x1292-1390: a 2x2 warichu label, right sub-line 込高 / left sub-line 新田 = 込高新田, printed with NO figure after it; the whole column band x1260-1420 is blank from y1400 to y1650 and from y1935 down to the foot of the page. The implied new-field increment (草高 − 本高 = 753.0341 koku) is simply not printed. Same column band, lower: 五年平均 (full-size, not warichu), the "five-year average" heading that governs the two tax-rice columns read next. (13) x1154-1238: 正税米 五千九百九十五石三斗二合三勺 = 5,995.3023. I first misread this as 五千九百十五 off the low-resolution overview; single-character zooms at 4x show 九(y1675-1735) 百(1761-1821) 九(1845-1899) 十(1928-1988) 五(2015-2069) 石(2098-2157) — the second 九 has the rounded bending leg and is plainly not 十, so the figure is 5,995 not 5,915. (14) x1025-1107: 雜税米 七拾二石五斗五升三合壹勺 = 72.5531. (15) x897-971: the running header 藩制一覽表第一（伯太） at y1345-1900 and, far below at y3183-3326, the printed book-page number 五十五 = 55.

ARITHMETIC NET, all three status groups: 士族 1,395 + 1,532 = 2,927 = printed total; 卒族 533 + 508 = 1,041 = printed total; 穢多 27 + 27 = 54 = printed total. Every koku string is strictly descending (草高 石>升>合>勺 with 斗 skipped; 正税米 石>斗>合>勺 with 升 skipped; 雜税米 石>斗>升>合>勺 complete). No disagreement with MASTER anywhere the two overlap.

PRIMARY DOMAIN: the leaf is split almost evenly — eight columns of 八戸藩 tail against six of 伯太藩 plus the header column — but the book's own header names （伯太）, the sole marker on the leaf is ○伯太藩, and printed page 55 is 伯太藩's page, so primary_domain_jp = 伯太藩 with 八戸藩 recorded as the right-of-marker neighbour.

GEOMETRY: every box is a flush ink-projection bbox (threshold px<120, 10px pad) enclosing label glyphs plus value glyphs. The three M/F pairs had their facing pads trimmed to the measured valley so no pair overlaps; an automated pairwise check over all 27 boxes reports zero overlaps. One overlay pass was rendered and read; no box clipped a glyph, sat on whitespace, or touched a neighbour, so no second pass was needed. Faint facing-page bleed-through around x1350-1450 / y2100-2400 and the dark binding edge left of x880 were deliberately left unboxed.

proposal.page_topic: Close of the Hachinohe entry (status populations, shrines, temples, villages, troops) and opening of the Hakuta entry (yields and tax rice)
proposal.page_summary_en: This half-leaf, printed book page 55 of fascicle one, carries two domains. The right-hand eight columns close Hachinohe's entry: 370 samurai households with 2,927 people (1,395 male, 1,532 female), 200 sotsu households with 1,041 people (533 male, 508 female), an outcaste (eta) population of 54 split evenly 27 and 27, 130 shrines, 53 temples plus 3 lodging temples and 19 hermitages, 83 villages, and a military establishment of one battalion of 462 men with an artillery corps of 85. The maru-marker ○伯太藩 then opens Hakuta domain (Izumi Province), whose surveyed yield is 14,273.0341 koku against a base yield of 13,520 koku, with regular tax rice of 5,995.3023 koku and miscellaneous tax rice of 72.5531 koku, both figures headed "five-year average." The new-field increment row 込高新田 is printed but left blank, so the 753.0341-koku difference between the surveyed and base yields is nowhere stated on the page.

neighbour_domains.evidence: All eighteen data boxes stand to the right of the sole maru-marker ○伯太藩 (x1690-1780) and so were read before it, closing the previous domain's entry. That entry is Hachinohe's: MASTER records 八戸藩 on this same pdf_page with 草高 四萬七十四石, 戸數 壹萬三千三百八十六軒 and 人口 六萬七千六百四十七人, and with the identical values transcribed here (兵隊一大隊 四百六十二人, 寺 五拾三ヶ寺, 神社 百三十社); the entry opens at book p.53 under a running header reading （八戸）. The status sub-counts boxed here (570 households, 4,022 people) are consistent subsets of those domain totals.

proposal.reasoning:
MARKERS: I searched the whole leaf for a maru-marker (circle + name + 藩) and there is none. No ○ appears anywhere on the page, so the right-to-left ownership rule has no boundary to apply here: this leaf is a continuation of a single domain's fascicle-1 block that began on an earlier leaf. Provenance is fixed by the running header in the left margin (x 903-977, y 1376-1953), which prints 藩制一覽表第一（庭瀬） -- Fascicle 1 of the Hansei Ichiran, Niwase. Every box therefore carries owner_domain_jp = 庭瀬藩. This matches MASTER, which assigns one row (庭瀬藩) to this page with fascicle/table 1.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT (an ink projection over x 800-2800, y 1000-3500 resolved 14 vertical runs; I then projected rows inside each run):
1. x 2634-2714 草高 貳萬五百七十三石七斗八升二合六勺五才 = 20,573.78265 koku. Read at 2x from a per-glyph montage; the sub-koku units run strictly descending 石>斗>升>合>勺>才. Identical to MASTER's parsed 20573.78265.
2. x 2508-2575 高 二萬石 = 20,000 koku, the official (omote) kokudaka. Niwase (Itakura house, Bitchū) was a 20,000-koku domain, and the kusadaka exceeds that figure by 573.78 koku.
3. x 2361-2443 正租米 一萬四百二十四石九斗四升二合四勺 = 10,424.9424 koku.
4. x 2228-2308 雜税金 三百三十兩永三百五十五文三步四厘.
5. x 2243-2292, y 2976-3154, in smaller type below the 雜税金 column: 八兩立. A conversion-rate note, not a datum.
6. x 2094-2173 合米 壹萬四百六拾六石二斗三升六合八勺一才 = 10,466.23681 koku.

ARITHMETIC NET (this is what confirms items 3-6 character by character): the 雜税金 cash figure, reckoned at 永一貫文 = 金一兩, is 330.35534 ryō. Divided by the printed 八兩立 rate that is 41.2944175 koku of rice. 10,424.9424 + 41.2944 = 10,466.23681 -- exactly the printed 合米 to the 才 place. So 合米 = 正租米 + 雜税金 converted at eight ryō per koku, and all four readings reconcile.

7. x 1973-2038 戸數 四千七百二十三戸 = 4,723 houses.
8. x 1838-1906 人口 二萬三百八十一人 = 20,381; below it the 内 split prints two side-by-side runs with a clean ink valley at x 1866: 女 九千七百八十五人 (left, 9,785) and 男 一萬五百九十六人 (right, 10,596). 10,596 + 9,785 = 20,381. Checks.
9. x 1778-1825, y 1133-1231, small type immediately left of the 人口 head: 外ニ. A structural marker ("besides the above") introducing the status groups enumerated in the columns that follow. Boxed, is_data false.
10. x 1702-1774 士族戸數 百六十二戸 = 162; the same column resumes lower down (y 2060-2877) with 卒族戸數 百六十八戸 = 168. Two separate boxes.
11. x 1537-1643 士族人口 五百二人 = 502, split at the x 1591 valley into 女 二百六十七人 (267) and 男 二百三十五人 (235). 235 + 267 = 502. Checks.
12. x 1403-1504 卒族人口 四百十六人 = 416, split at the x 1453 valley into 女 百七十人 (170) and 男 二百七十六人 (276). 276 + 170 = 446, which does NOT equal the printed total 416. I re-zoomed all three numbers at single-character magnification: the total is unambiguously 四百十六 (plain-cross 十 then lidded 六, not 四), the male figure is unambiguously 二百七十六, and the female figure is unambiguously 百七十 (hooked 七, not 四). The 30-person discrepancy is in the source itself, not in my reading; I transcribe all three as printed.
13. x 1298-1369 穢多戸數 百六十三戸 = 163, and lower in the same column 人口 八百六十一人 = 861.
14. x 1168-1237 非人戸數 十九戸 = 19, and lower 人口, with the two smaller glyphs 茶筅 (verified at 5x -- grass radical over 木, then bamboo radical over 先) set inline as a gloss naming the local outcast group, then 八十一人（非人番四戸）= 81 persons, four of whose households did hinin-ban watch duty. The gloss sits inside the same column run and is kept inside the 非人人口 box rather than split off, because splitting it would cut the label away from its value.
15. x 1024-1112 神社 五十八社 = 58 shrines; then a parenthetical that opens at y 1784 and closes at y 2931: （社人戸數十九戸 ... 社人 女四十人 男十二人）. The shrine-attendant male/female pair splits at a zero-ink valley at x 1054-1057. 12 + 40 = 52 attendants in 19 households. The shared 社人 label sits centred above both sub-columns (x 1024-1088), so it gets its own small non-data box rather than being cut in half between the male and female boxes.
16. x 913-967 the running header, and x 896-944 at y 3228-3369 the printed book-page number 六十三 = 63, in the smaller marginal face.

No bleed-through, binding-edge black, or scan-frame ink was boxed. Thirty boxes, machine-checked for pairwise overlap: zero. Two overlay passes; the only correction made after pass 1 was the 人口 total box, whose bottom had been set by a y-restricted projection and clipped the 人 of 二萬三百八十一人 -- extended to y 2037, with the male/female pair moved down to start at 2042.
proposal.page_topic: Niwase land assessment, tax, households and status-group population
proposal.page_summary_en: This leaf carries the fascicle-1 economic and demographic block for Niwase domain in Bitchū province, a 20,000-koku Itakura holding whose surveyed gross yield (草高) was 20,573.78265 koku. Regular land tax in rice came to 10,424.9424 koku and miscellaneous cash taxes to 330 ryō 355.34 mon; converted at the eight-ryō rate printed in the margin, the two sum exactly to the recorded combined total of 10,466.23681 koku. The domain reported 4,723 households and 20,381 commoners (10,596 male, 9,785 female), and separately 162 shizoku households with 502 persons, 168 sotsu households with 416 persons, 163 eta households with 861 persons, and 19 hinin households (locally called chasen) with 81 persons. Fifty-eight shrines are recorded, staffed by 52 attendants in 19 households; the printed sotsu total of 416 does not match its own male and female components, which sum to 446.
